thread:
maya: Quick sync — trying to tighten postmortem follow-ups. proposal below, hoping for owners and feedback.

maya: TL;DR: implement a 3-step remediation cadence (Triage -> Short-term fix -> Long-term remediation), weekly pulse for open actions, and rotating remediation owner for recurring patterns.

priya: 👍 can you paste the cadence template here?

maya: sure — thinking something like:
```
1) Day 0-3: Triage + immediate mitigation (IC + oncall)
2) Day 4-14: Short-term fix owner assigned (P0/P1) with 2-week deliverable
3) Day 15-45: Long-term remediation owner + spec + rollout plan
4) Weekly: remediation pulse for all open items older than 7 days
5) 90-day: recurring-pattern review (if similar incidents >2)
```

alex: looks good. question: who runs the weekly pulse? ICs rotate and will be different each week.

maya: proposed: ops coordinator (sre rotation) runs the pulse meeting and triggers the weekly update thread. ICs + remediation owners must post status.

dave: I can take ops coordinator for next 2 weeks to kick this off. also we should capture owners in the postmortem metadata so they show up in the weekly dashboard.

oncall-bot: Reminder: add `remediation_owner` and `remediation_eta` fields to the postmortem template. See /incident-templates.

priya: Can we also add a small enforcement rule: if an action moves past ETA, auto-notify owner + manager? reduces ghosted items.

maya: yes — automation plan: on ETA miss -> create slack thread mention owner + manager + add to next weekly pulse list. who can build that?

alex: I can add a webhook that watches the postmortem tracker. will need the tracker schema (fields) tho.

maya: tracker fields for the webhook: incident_id, remediation_owner, remediation_eta, priority, current_status. I'll put a short spec in the doc.

sarah: one more datapoint — recurring pattern detection would be simple text-match on the summary + service tag, but let's not overfit. start with manual triage for first 3 recurrences.

maya: agreed. action items:
- dave: run ops coordinator for 2 weeks and kick off first weekly pulse (owner)
- alex: implement webhook to auto-notify on ETA misses (tracking fields above)
- priya: update postmortem template to include new fields + add brief how-to for owners
- maya: add cadence template and recurrence criteria to /incident-playbooks and schedule a 30m walkthrough next Wed

priya: I updated the template draft in the doc, linking to the pulse agenda. will assign owners in current open PMs.

dave: started a thread for this week's pulse: <https://redwood.internal/threads/1972502001|weekly-remediations-week-1>

maya: thanks all. if anyone wants to rotate into ops coordinator earlier ping me. short sync next Wed 10:30. :calendar:
